annotation: Manual standoff annotations from the source repository; per-document quality_checked values remain in raw test.json.
policy: Each document-annotator pair is scored separately; documents repeat and rows are not statistically independent. Report per-annotator metrics; any pooled score is descriptive and weights documents by number of annotations, with no independence or confidence-interval claim. Preserve each original half-open span and all overlaps. An optional conservative secondary view may union DIRECT/QUASI character spans across annotators per document, but report separately as a coverage upper bound. Generic PII is used for unsupported entity types, while source_type retains the original category.
use: evaluation only; never training or tuning
